wm-11381374703.description: Just when you thought audio couldn't get any better, the Apple AirPods 4 redefine what it means to experience sound. These iconic earbuds have evolved into a supersonic marvel, offering a completely transformed audio experience that immerses you in theater-like sound. With Personalized Spatial Audio and dynamic head tracking, AirPods 4 create a three-dimensional listening environment, enveloping you in sound whether you're enjoying music, TV shows, movies, or games.Powered by the advanced H2 chip, AirPods 4 deliver a roaring leap in capabilities, enhancing both audio and call quality. These earbuds adapt intelligently to any listening environment, offering features like Voice Isolation, which uses computational audio to minimize background noise and clarify your voice, ensuring superclear call quality even in loud or windy conditions.The new acoustic architecture of AirPods 4 is a testament to Apple's innovation, featuring a low-distortion driver and a custom high dynamic range amplifier. This combination allows you to hear music in exceptional detail, with deeper bass and crystal-clear highs. The Adaptive EQ further personalizes your listening experience by automatically tuning music to your ears, adjusting low and midrange frequencies for rich detail in every song.Stay connected with real-time clarity on FaceTime, thanks to the AAC-ELD speech codec, and enjoy more lifelike Group FaceTime calls with support for Personalized Spatial Audio. Redesigned for comfort, AirPods 4 offer an exceptional fit and all-day comfort with a refined contour and new internal architecture that provides greater stability during movement.The updated stem features a force sensor for easy control of playback and calls with a simple pinch. Rated IP54 for dust, sweat, and water resistance, AirPods 4 and their charging case are built to withstand everything from rain to intense workouts. The streamlined charging case is more than 10 percent smaller than its predecessor, yet it offers up to 30 hours of listening time with the case and up to 5 hours on a single charge.With USB-C charging capabilities, AirPods 4 ensure fast and convenient power-ups. They pair instantly with any device connected to your Apple ID, offering seamless transitions across iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. The earbuds detect when you remove them, pausing playback until they're back in your ears.Track your AirPods 4 effortlessly with the Find My app, receiving separation alerts if they stray out of Bluetooth range. Siri is always on standby, ready to assist with music, calls, directions, or schedule checks. You can even nod or shake your head to manage notifications without speaking. Share audio easily between two sets of AirPods by bringing them near your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV for instant connection.Experience the future of sound with Apple AirPods 4, where innovation meets unparalleled audio performance.
features: REBUILT FOR COMFORT—AirPods 4 have been redesigned for exceptional all-day comfort and greater stability. With a refined contour, shorter stem, and quick-press controls for music or calls.

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO—Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theater-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games, and more.

IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY—AirPods 4 feature the Apple-designed H2 chip. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions. Using advanced computational audio, it reduces background noise while isolating and clarifying the sound of your voice for whoever you’re speaking to.

MAGICAL EXPERIENCE—Just say “Siri” or “Hey Siri” to play a song, make a call, or check your schedule. And with Siri Interactions, now you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no. Pair AirPods 4 by simply placing them near your device and tapping Connect on your screen. Easily share a song or show between two sets of AirPods. A skin-detecting sensor knows to play audio only when you’re wearing AirPods and pauses when you take them off. And you can track down your AirPods and Charging Case with the Find My app.
LONG BATTERY LIFE—Get up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge. And get up to 30 hours of total listening time using the case.
REDESIGNED CASE—The Charging Case comes with USB-C charging capabilities and is more than 10 percent smaller by volume than the previous generation.
DUST, SWEAT, AND WATER RESISTANT—AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant, so they’ll withstand rain and heavy workouts.

When the dog relieves himself on the pad, praise him and reward him with a treat. Rewarding him will let him know he is doing what you want him to .Dispose of soiled pad and replace when needed. Once your dog is relieving himself on a regular basis on the pad, begin moving the pad closer to the door and eventually outdoors. This will complete the training process. Consistency, praise and patience will help you and your puppy!
